# cayley-dickson-terrace-frontier (`0TH-2026-019`, `v3.0.0`)

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formalization (28 headline theorems `T1a`–`T6c`, 29 Palomar targets, 45 audited declarations), Rust/ISO C11/Python differential verifiers, interactive WCAG 2.2 AA 3D Canvas observatory, and 24-page AMS-LaTeX white paper proving the Dyadic-Palindromic Terrace Law, Nilpotent Mirror Conservation & Exact Kernel Basis, Dimension-64 Coordinate Right-Multiplier Rupture, Sedenion Triple-42 Duality, Pure-Kernel Pathion Ceiling $r_{\max}(\mathrm{CD}_5) = 14$ with Strict $7+7$ Rigidity, All-$n$ Binary Reflected Gray-Code Bit-Locking & Complete Spectral-Gap Dichotomy ($2^{n-3}-4$ gapped masks), and Universal Odd-Parity Zero-Divisor Exclusion via Fraction-Free Odd-Pivot Integral Matrix Inversion.

## Canonical Entry Points
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quickstart commands, visual preview, and verbatim 45-declaration Lean 4.35.0 `#print axioms` audit.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Complete theorem-by-theorem ledger (`T1a`–`T6c`, `C1`–`C2`) with `[LEAN-6K]` / `[EXACT-COMP]` tags.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit epistemic boundaries and open problems not claimed solved.
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Complete resolution record of all 23 v1.0.0 audit entries and all 34 Cycle 1–3 hardening findings closed through `v2.1.0` (preserved in `v3.0.0`).
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Step-by-step clean-clone reproduction commands.
- [HARDENING_INDEX.md](HARDENING_INDEX.md) & [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): Three-cycle deep-dive hardening index and changelog.
- [lean/formalization.yaml](lean/formalization.yaml): Machine-readable Lean 4.35.0 proof metadata, Palomar disclosures, & 6-kernel manifest.
- [lean/Challenge.lean](lean/Challenge.lean): Statement-only abbreviations `T1aStmt`–`T6cStmt` and `AllTerraceTheoremsStmt`.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Proof architecture, 6-pillar Lean dependency design, binary-tree clique cover, and tri-language differential verification.
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Palomar Comparator statement-to-paper fidelity mapping (`v3.0.0`, 28/28 theorems + `ALL`, automated Lean-symbol guard).
- [docs/gold-standard-checklist.md](docs/gold-standard-checklist.md): Transparent 43-item Playbook v1.3 Gold Standard Release Checklist.
- [docs/literature-search-log.md](docs/literature-search-log.md) & [docs/submission-packet.md](docs/submission-packet.md): Programmatic live Crossref/arXiv citation audit log and archival submission packet.
